headline: SK Group's chairman said that demand for semiconductors will keep rising quickly, during a visit to SK hynix's planned chip hub in South Korea.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: a short executive remark with no figures; modest news value.
importance_line: It shows confidence at a leading memory-chip group that AI-driven demand will last, but it is an opinion with no figures given in the short report, so it changes little.
summary: Reuters reports that SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won said on 9 Oct 2026, during a visit to the site of a new semiconductor hub for SK hynix in South Korea, that demand for chips is expected to keep growing at a fast pace.
notes: Reuters page returned 401; the short wire text was read in a copy on Central Oregon Daily, which carries Reuters (Joyce Lee and Hyunjoo Jin reporting). The wire is one paragraph.
